messages.content: Can you provide me with the fastest route from my home in San Francisco to my office in Palo Alto and then a scenic route from Palo Alto to the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco, and finally the fastest route back to my home from the Golden Gate Bridge?

function.name: get_directions
function.description: Retrieve directions from one location to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point of the journey.

end_location.description: The destination point of the journey.

route_type.description: Type of route to use (e.g., fastest, scenic). Default is fastest.

• Merge onto *US‑101 S* via the ramp off Market/Van Ness. | | **Main freeway:** | • Follow *US‑101 S* through Daly City and San Mateo.
• Keep left at the interchange for *I‑680 S* (signage “San Jose”).
• Stay on *I‑680 S* for ~15 mi. | | **Exit to Palo Alto:** | • At the *I‑680 S → I‑280 N* junction, keep right to stay on *I‑680 S*.
• Continue straight onto *I‑280 N* (the sign reads “Palo Alto”); this merges with *I‑680 S* briefly before diverging. | | **Final stretch:** | • Take the *I‑280 N → US‑101 S* exit toward *Mountain View/Palo Alto* (~10 mi).
• Turn right onto *US‑101 S*, then immediately take the *exit for CA‑84 E* (toward *Stanford*).
• Follow *CA‑84 E* into Palo Alto; arrive at your office around the intersection of *University Ave.* and *College Ave.* | **Estimated travel time:** ≈ 45–55 minutes (depending on traffic). --- ### Route 2 – Scenic drive from Palo Alto to the Golden Gate Bridge | Leg | Directions | |-----|------------| | **Start:** Palo Alto (near College Ave.) | • Begin on *CA‑84 W* heading toward *Woodside*. | | **Highway 35 (Skyline Blvd):** | • As soon as possible, transition onto *CA‑35 North* (Skyline Blvd) via the exit at *Stinson Beach Rd.*
• Enjoy sweeping ocean vistas, rolling hills, and occasional wildlife sightings. | | **Half Moon Bay & beyond:** | • Continue on *CA‑35 N* through *Half Moon Bay*—stop at the beach if desired.
• Pass through *Baker Beach* and *Moss Landing* for dramatic cliff views. | | **Merge onto US‑101 N:** | • Near *San Pedro Square* (just outside San Francisco), *CA‑35* terminates; merge onto *US‑101 N* toward San Francisco. | | **Cross the Bay Bridge:** | • Travel northbound on *US‑101 N* until you hit the *Golden Gate Bridge* entrance.
